description: A single freeform note per day.

data.note: Started a small lifting program: 3x5 squat, bench, row. Felt awkward but good.
Cut coffee after midday for two days running. Sleep noticeably deeper.
Long walk along the river. Took photos. Calmer afternoon than usual.
Worked through the renderer plan at the pub. Drew it out on a napkin.
Wrist still a little tight from yesterday's lift. Light day tomorrow.
Prepping a public demo of the dashboard. Curious to see what people poke at first.
